notes: Covers phase-04 Steps 8-12 directly against TimerService and ExamAppBar: (1) seedFromTask phase derivation for prep/response/already-expired; (2) reconcileFromServer resetting the Stopwatch-derived remaining time and adopting response.phase directly even when the response's own serverNow/deadlines would derive a different phase; (3) taskAdvancedExternally emitted only on a currentOrderIndex change, exactly once per change; (4) dispose() cancelling the poll scheduler and closing both streams, verified via a fake TimerScheduler capturing (duration, callback) pairs with zero real-time waiting; (5) ExamAppBar's BlocSelector rebuild-avoidance, verified as an executed widget test via widget-instance identity comparison across pumps (an unrelated AttemptInProgress change leaves the countdown Text object identical; a genuine TimerSnapshot change produces a new one). Also added a targeted regression test for the startPolling-called-twice-without-stop() orphaned-chain fix: a stale callback captured by a superseded chain is confirmed inert (no duplicate fetchTimerState calls, no duplicate ticks emissions) while the live chain continues to function. Full `flutter test` run (79 tests across the whole repo) passed with zero failures and zero skips. No production code was modified — only new test files and one test-infrastructure fix (a missing mocktail registerFallbackValue in the pre-existing exam_attempt_bloc_test.dart, needed for its existing timerService.seedFromTask(any()) stub to run; the assertions themselves were not touched).
